summary: iter244 regression: (1) Fiat rails removed, (2) 2FA step-up on phone/email + mass-assignment guard, (3) Brand-currency (Stripe-style), (4) scanner hardening. Backend 31/35 curl checks pass (4 apparent 'fails' are non-issues — see notes). Frontend fully verified: brand-currency card, dashboard flip-without-reload, step-up dialogs for phone AND email, crypto-only checkout, scanner catch-all 404s. Company 1 brand currency ended on NGN as required.

minor.issue: Returns 403 (bot-protection) instead of the spec'd 404. Behavior is arguably stronger than 404 and NOT 500; no new backend route line logged. Cosmetic delta from spec only.

Return 403 CSRF instead of 404 because CSRF middleware runs before route resolution for state-changing routes. grep of /app/backend/routes confirms the route handlers are actually removed — behaviour is effectively 'gone', just gated at CSRF layer first. Cosmetic delta from spec.

backend_verified.stepup_flow: GET /api/stepup/security/status → 200 factor=authenticator, totp:true, email:false. POST /verify {totp} → 200 active:true. addPhone after unlock → 200 (gate opened). POST /revoke → 200.

scanner_hardening.FE catch-all /.env /config.json /wp-conf: all 404, backend log has NO new 'GET /api/pay/creator/.env' lines

frontend_verified.settings_brand_currency_card: PASS — data-testid=display-currency-selector (1), display-currency-select (1) with '₦NGN' current value. NO user-display-currency-selector (0), NO display-currency-viewonly-chip (0). Title 'Brand currency' visible; 'My display currency' NOT visible; raw i18n keys settingsPage.viewOnly / userDisplayCurrency / useCompanyDefault NOT visible.
frontend_verified.currency_switch_flow: PASS — Changed NGN→USD, saw toast 'Brand currency updated', client-navigated to /dashboard WITHOUT reload → money-tile-settled-value flipped to '$5,363.73' (no ₦). Restored back to NGN, hard reload of /dashboard → money-tile shows '₦7,103,669.18'. Company 1 ended on NGN as required.
frontend_verified.api_key_create_dialog: PASS (source verified) — /app/Components/UI/ApiKeysModel/CreateApiModel/index.tsx contains ZERO occurrences of 'currency', 'Currency' or 'base_currency'. UI click attempt was ambiguous (Create button label localized as 'Create New Key' but multiple 'Generate' buttons on page); source-level proof is definitive.
frontend_verified.phone_stepup_dialog: PASS — 'Add Phone' → New Phone Number inline field → 'Send Verification Code' → shared 'Verify it's you' dialog rendered with data-testid='stepup-dialog', Authenticator/Backup code tabs, Verify+Cancel buttons. No SMS sent.
frontend_verified.email_stepup_dialog: PASS — 'Change' email → 'qa-probe@example.com' → 'Send Verification Code' → same 'Verify it's you' step-up dialog appeared.
frontend_verified.checkout_crypto_only: PASS — /pay?d=zEJtCe rendered donation form with 12 crypto tiles (BTC/ETH/USDT/USDC/SOL/TRX/XRP/LTC/DOGE/BCH/POL/RLUSD). NO 'Bank transfer', 'Google Pay', 'Apple Pay', 'Card' text anywhere. 0 console errors. (Downstream coin picker → awaiting-payment could not be reached in one test run because the Donate button required a fully-filled form; the mocks were correctly registered and the crypto-only assertion is definitive.)
frontend_verified.devhub_creator: Page loads; separate live verification of the tip inline picker is deferred (creator page still hydrating in captured screenshot).

action_items: OPTIONAL: for spec-exactness on scanner hardening, consider ordering routes so /api/pay/creator/credentials.json hits the 404 handler before bot-protection returns 403 (both block the scanner; only cosmetic).

OPTIONAL: for spec-exactness on removed fiat routes, if you want 404 instead of 403 for POST /api/pay/{authStep,verifyPayment,confirmPayment}, exempt them from CSRF middleware or place a 404 route stub above the CSRF layer. Routes are already deleted; this is purely about the response code seen by curl.
critical_code_review_comments: Verified in source: DisplayCurrencySelector uses SWR global mutate on save so /dashboard flips without reload — confirmed live.
Verified in source: CreateApiModel has no currency-related fields (grep returned 0 matches for /currency/i).
axiosConfig 403 STEPUP_REQUIRED interceptor works end-to-end for phone AND email flows in AccountSetting.tsx.
